caption: The drawing depicts an object composed of two elongated, jointed metal arms forming an upside-down "L" shape, connected by a central pivot or hinge. The horizontal arm has a series of engraved geometric patterns, consisting of diamonds and lines, and terminates at the right end with a hook that curves downward. At the left end, it features an additional smaller hooked element that bends back toward the central axis. The vertical arm, attached perpendicularly at the central joint, is plain with a few round holes and a small protruding knob near its lower end. The entire object is rendered in shades of brown and gray, with darker outlines and light detailing to indicate shadow and metallic texture, set against an off-white or cream background with no additional elements or patterns.
title: Latch
